subject.title: Feature Request: Custom TUI Footer Fields for Cost/Balance/Rate Limit Status

question: Should persistent TUI footer customization be implemented as TUI config/templates, a PluginStatusProvider SDK surface, cached provider-usage state, or a combined design?
rationale: The requested behavior creates new public config or Plugin SDK surface and may add provider credential polling to a live UI path, so code inspection cannot choose the product boundary safely.

options.title: Plugin/API-driven footer status
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/72557 and the broader tracker to define a plugin-owned status-provider seam, then wire TUI rendering with bounded/cached provider usage where needed.

options.title: Core config template
options.body: Add a first-class `tui.footer` template/config surface in core, accepting the compatibility and schema/docs burden for user-configured footer fields.

options.title: Keep status surfaces separate
options.body: Reject persistent footer customization for now and steer users to `/status`, `/usage`, CLI status, and community plugins for cost/balance observability.

recommendation.title: Plugin/API-driven footer status
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/72557 and the broader tracker to define a plugin-owned status-provider seam, then wire TUI rendering with bounded/cached provider usage where needed.

likelyOwner.reason: History and discussion tie this person to provider-usage/status boundaries and current TUI footer/config behavior.
